name: 架空峠 ロング・ワインディング(緩斜面)
desc: 架空の長い連続カーブ(緩いS字が延々と続く)。緩斜面(高低差15m相当)。大きめのRで速度を保ちやすく、リズム良く流す走りの練習に。
desc_en: A fictional long stretch of continuous curves (gentle S-curves that go on and on). Gentle slope (about 15 m of elevation change). The large radii make it easy to carry speed — good practice for flowing along in a rhythm.
